title: Understanding Parenting Orders
learningGoal: Help parents understand the purpose of parenting orders and how to follow them safely.
microLesson: Parenting orders outline responsibilities, contact arrangements, and safety requirements. Following orders consistently shows insight, reliability, and commitment to the child’s wellbeing. Clear communication and cooperation reduce conflict.
activity: Identify one part of your parenting order you can follow more consistently. Reflect on why it matters.
